compiled_state.title: ticket-lib-api.sh: _alias_stderr mktemp not in trap -> temp file leaks when python3 fails
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description: In ticket_create() subshell, _alias_stderr is allocated via mktemp at ~line 786 but is not included in the trap at ~line 838 (which only covers temp_event and desc_file). If python3 fails, set -euo pipefail exits the subshell before the explicit rm -f, leaking the temp file. Fix: add _alias_stderr to the trap immediately after mktemp.
